title: [JSConfUS 2013] Tom Occhino and Jordan Walke: JS Apps at Facebook
summary: Tom Occhino and Jordan Walke present how Facebook builds JavaScript apps, in the talk where React was first publicly announced at JSConf US 2013.
why: Cited as the original React presentation and to credit Jordan Walke as its creator.

quote.text: Watch the original JSConf talk where React was publicly announced and released
